meta.title: PDF to Word - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert PDF files to editable Word documents (.docx) in your browser. Text and structure extracted locally — no upload.
arrangePages: Arrange pages — drag to set custom order
reorderFilesResets: Reordering files above resets the page arrangement
dragReorderClickSplit: Drag pages to reorder · Click ✂ between pages to split
compressRasterNote: Pages are rasterized — text will not be searchable in the compressed output.
encryptNoteText: The encrypted .enc file can be decrypted using the PDF Decrypt tool. Use PDF Decrypt to restore the original PDF.
encryptedDownloaded: Encrypted file downloaded! Use PDF Decrypt to restore it.
decryptFormatNote: • .enc files created by the PDF Encrypt tool on this site (AES-256-GCM)
noTextFoundCsv: No text found. This PDF may use image-based content which cannot be extracted without OCR.
pdfToWordNote: Text-based conversion — text and paragraph structure are extracted. Complex layouts, images, and tables may not be preserved.
wordToPdfNote: Text-based conversion — text content is extracted and laid out in a clean PDF. Complex styles, images, and tables may not transfer.
dropImagesHere: Drop images here or click to upload
imgFormatHint: JPG · PNG · WebP · Max {maxMB} MB each · Max {maxFiles} images
dragHandleHint: Drag the handle on the left to reorder pages
steps_pdf-to-word_1Desc: Select the PDF to convert to Word format. The converter preserves text, formatting, images, and layout as closely as possible to the original.
steps_pdf-to-word_2Desc: Click Convert to transform your PDF into an editable Word document. Conversion runs locally — your document content never leaves your browser.
steps_pdf-to-word_3Desc: Download the .docx file and open it in Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or LibreOffice. Edit, format, and collaborate freely with the converted document.
desc: Convert PDF files to editable Word documents (.docx) in your browser. Text and structure extracted locally — no upload.
